thread:
morgan: Heads-up — eu-west deploy window starts in ~10m. I'm going to post SLO snapshots during the rollout. Please watch slo-service, prefix-cache, and generation-p95. If anything crosses the thresholds, ping @oncall and tag #eng-oncall.

deploybot: Deploy scheduled for eu-west. Change window 30m. Canary phases: 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Version: v2026.03.20-rc4. Auto-rollout enabled with canary pause on SLO breach.

devon: noted. I'll monitor the prefix-cache and kvcache heatmaps.

sanjay: saw a small p95 bump on staging earlier after the GC tweak; I added a conservative GC delay to canary config (testing). Will report if it stabilizes.

morgan: posting initial SLO snapshot (baseline before shift): https://observability.internal/snapshots/3419876543

observability-bot: SLO snapshot summary:
```
service: slo-service
  p95: 120ms (baseline)
  error_rate: 0.12%
prefix-cache:
  p95: 95ms
  miss_rate: 0.8%
generation-p95:
  p95: 210ms
  tail_outliers: 0.9%
Alert thresholds: p95 > 200ms (5m), error_rate > 0.5% (3m)
```

alex: quick reminder — rollback criteria in the runbook: p95 >200ms for 5m OR error_rate >0.5% for 3m triggers pause + rollback. We should be explicit about who hits the button.

morgan: agreed — if either condition is met, oncall or deploy lead should pause and pin traffic back. I'll proactively add pin instructions in the rollout message.

observability-bot: Canary traffic shifted to 5% at t+2m. Monitoring windows starting.

(dev: ~8m later)

observability-bot: Alert: generation-p95 exceeded 210ms on canary for 2m. Current: 225ms. Error rate still 0.15%.

devon: I can see the spike on the gen tail. Looks correlated with longer seq lengths from a single upstream customer in the canary slice.

sanjay: rolling back the GC tweak for the canary override now — applying config revert.

observability-bot: Canary traffic paused by deploy lead. Traffic pinned back to v2026.03.19-stable.

morgan: pin complete. Canary paused and traffic routed to previous version. Not rolling back cluster-wide. Creating a follow-up ticket for kvcache/gen tail investigation: https://tracker.internal/ISSUE-4821

alex: good call. We'll re-run a trimmed canary after root cause analysis.

devon: leaving probes running on a small shadow slice to capture more traces for the failing requests.

sanjay: I'll add a targeted sampling rule to surface the long-seq traces and post logs within 20m.

morgan: thanks all. Postmortem/notes in the ticket; we'll decide next steps after traces. Will reopen the window when we have the GC variant that doesn't spike gen-p95. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: Snapshot after pause: generation-p95 (canary): 230ms (peak), pinned to v2026.03.19-stable.

alex: FYI — adding a quick blameless blip note to the deploy thread. We'll coordinate with product for any customer outreach if needed.

morgan: closing the active watch for now. Reopen if new alerts fire. Thanks team.
